title: Sports science:module 206
titleCn: 运动科学206模块：人体实验研究项目申请

paragraphs.text: Part four. You will hear a lecturer speaking to a group of sports science students about their research project. First, you have some time to look at questions thirty-one to forty.
Now listen carefully and answer questions thirty-one to forty.

So I hope that’s given you an idea of the main problems involved in this area. Okay, so that’s the end of the lecture, but I’d like to ask everyone in the Sports Science Year two, Module two-oh-six to stay behind, please. I think that’s nearly all of you, in fact, as there’s some information I need to give you.
Uh, right. Have we got everybody here?
Okay. Now, could you each take a copy of this form? This is to do with your main research project this term for Module two-oh-six.

Uh, by now, I hope you’ve all got an idea of, of what sort of thing you’re going to study for your project. Uh, as you know, this is concerned with the physiological effects of exercise. That is, its effects on the human body. So your research is going to be linked to how exercise affects people. So probably you’re going to need to do an investigation on human subjects. Now, if you’re doing experiments on people, you’ve obviously got to be very careful that you don’t harm them in any way. So before you approach your subjects and ask them to participate, you have to complete this form.

Now, you’ll find this is quite time-consuming. First of all, you need to get the information for your application together. Then the application form needs to be signed by your tutor, and then after he or she’s signed it, it has to be copied and sent on to the subcommittee for approval. So you do need to get going as soon as possible on this because the, uh, uh, you’ll find the subcommittee’s approval can take up to a week to come through. Well, maybe a week if you’re lucky. Uh, can you then let me have a copy? And I really need that by November fourteenth. It’s important that you complete this form correctly, so I’ll just talk you through it now.
Okay, have you, uh, have you each got a copy of it?

Right. So the first thing you need to put is the title of your project, the full title. That should be fairly straightforward. And then after that, you have to give details of the investigators. That’s the person or the people carrying out the project. So if you’re doing a group project, you need all your names. And as well as that, you need to indicate what the qualifications of the investigators are and the part they’re each playing in the project. So their qualifications and role. Okay, so that’s the second point.

Going on to the third point, which is the purpose of the research. You need a fair amount of detail here. As I said, this form does go on to the subcommittee to be approved, and they do need to know if the project is worth doing, and they need to be able to form an opinion about its value. So make sure you include enough details so that they can do this.

Okay, the next category says the experimental subjects. Subjects here obviously means the subjects of the experiment, the people who are being experimented on. And here you have to give the number of people who are going to be involved as subjects, the people being experimented on, and as well as the number, what criteria you’re going to use to include or exclude them, like their age, for example. And you also have to describe the method you’re going to use to recruit them. How you’re actually, um, how you’re going to find these people, like through advertisements, for example.

Right. The next point is design of the study. Here you need to outline how you’re going to conduct your experiment. And as well as giving a general outline, you need to actually say the place where you’re going to do the study. Like, is it going to be in the gym? Is it going to be in the lab? Is it going to be inside the school or outside the school? That sort of thing.

Going on to procedures, you need to describe the procedures to be used in the study, and it’s particularly important here to identify the possible risks and discomforts for your subjects and to go into as much detail as possible about the measures you’re going to take to minimize these. It’s very, very important that you don’t impose unnecessary risk or discomfort on your subject.
You do need also to see the school safety officer and in consultation with him to carry out the risk assessment. That needs confirming in this section that you’ve done that.
So you need to contact him, and he’s called Chris Thorpe. Thorpe with an E.
Okay, any questions so far?
No?

Good. So going on to the next section, uh, which is on finance. You need to give details if you’re getting any sort of award to help you with your project or if there’s been any outside sponsorship of your study.
So if you’ve had sponsorship from a charity or from a commercial organization, you’d put that down there.
Okay. Finally, can you put the starting point and the expected duration of the project, uh, how long you expect it to last, and your signature and date.
Right. So if any of you want to stay behind and discuss this with me...
That is the end of part four. You now have one minute to check your answers to part four.
